biography.value: Thunder Giants hit hard enough that their pushback mechanics start repositioning groups rather than individuals. Chain Bolt's secondary targeting means they can apply Dazed or Stunned to clustered enemies with a single ranged action. Storm Aura's wind interference makes them naturally difficult for archers to engage while the storm presence pushes melee fighters back. A summoner who positions one between enemies and open ground will find the battlefield steadily pushed in a direction that favors the summoner's allies.

system.attacksNotes:
Storm Fist [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 5), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 11 damage (6 + 5 Str) + 3 lightning damage (Half DR); target pushed 15 feet.
  • Margin 2: 11 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 lightning damage; pushed 15 feet + Stunned until end of their next turn; no save.
  • Margin 3: 11 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 lightning damage + Stunned + Deafened for 1 minute; all creatures within 10 feet of target take 4 lightning damage from the discharge.

Chain Bolt [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 4), Range: 80 ft, up to 2 additional targets within 20 feet of the first.

  • Margin 1:: 13 lightning damage (10 + 3 Dex).
  • Margin 2: 13 lightning damage, DR halved (round up) + Dazed until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 3: 13 lightning damage, DR halved (round up) + Stunned until end of their next turn.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Storm Aura: Ranged ### Attacks passing within 15 feet of the Thunder Giant add 1 to both dice from severe wind interference. Creatures starting their turn within 10 feet make a Fortitude [Easy] save or are pushed 5 feet directly away. Powerful Build: The Thunder Giant counts as Gargantuan for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Momentum: When the Thunder Giant moves at least 20 feet before making a melee attack, subtract 1 from both attack dice on that attack Resilient Defense (1/day): When the Thunder Giant fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
